# Period-48 PP code with check weight ten

The construction [pp-f4-768-192-w10](../../codes/pp-quaternary/pp-f4-768-192-w10/code.json)
has exact parameters **[[768,192,22]]**, maximum binary check weight **10**,
maximum column weight **5**, and a full regular canonical frame of achieved
width **29**. The optimized width is bounded by 22 <= f <= 29; width 29 is
not asserted optimal.

Run the portable audit from any directory with Python 3.10 or later:

```sh
python3 /path/to/regular-logical-frames/verification/pp48_w10_bound/check.py
```

The audit reconstructs the physical checks and four seed pairs, verifies ranks
288/288 and all 36,864 translated canonical pairings, checks the weight-22
logical outside the stabilizer span, and verifies reflection between sectors.
The redundant trace rows used for exclusion have the same stabilizer span as
the reported checks.

All 64 disjoint weight-21 exclusion pieces completed: all executions report full completion. Each covers all 16 translation-root types. Their
common frontier contains 13,360 branches; ownership sums to exactly that
count, with the same frontier digest for every piece. The completed executions
visited 9,980,458,148 nodes, including repeated common prefixes. The checker
binds each receipt to its inputs, source manifest, executable and output, and
checks the completed status and full partition coverage. Together with the
physical witness and reflection, this establishes d_X = d_Z = 22.

[completed/](completed/) preserves all inputs, source, build records, receipts
and transcripts; [completion_audit.json](completion_audit.json) summarizes the
local audit of the downloaded evidence. Auditing completed executions does
not replay the deep search or provide a formal node-by-node proof object.

The reversing 3-by-8 construction uses F4[t]/(t^48-1), pivot columns (0,1,2)
and (4,5,6), and free columns (3,7). Field labels 0,1,2,3 mean
0,1,omega,omega^2. Binary coordinates are `(2*column+component)*48+position`
in the self-dual trace basis (omega,omega^2), with zero-based indices.
The determinant is `1+t^15+t^18+t^39+t^42` and its square is 1, so the
cofactor frame needs no further pairing normalization. X seed weights are
(28,28,28,29); paired Z seed weights are (28,29,28,28).

Receipts are metadata-normalized copies. Included input/source/transcript hashes
bind the public files. Executable fingerprints are declared only; no binary is
distributed. See ../../docs/PACKAGING.md.
